methodology: Offline synthetic candidate evaluation only. CandidateIsolationForestV2 is fit on the 768 unlabeled training reference vectors before validation scoring; validation labels are used only for threshold selection and the pre-registered improvement gate. The candidate selection is frozen, including its model metadata digest, before the independent fresh holdout (seed 20261107) is generated. The old evaluation holdout seed 20261106 and its calibration labels are not used. Production remains on the v1 threshold 0.65; no model or runtime configuration is activated. Scores are anomaly-ranking signals, not probabilities, and synthetic scenario labels are not observed fraud outcomes.

model.decision_rule: threshold views are offline simulations; production threshold remains 0.65
model.disclaimer: Synthetic scenario performance is not real-fraud performance and scores are not calibrated fraud probabilities.
